collections.name: All Clubs
collections.lede: Wedges, putters and a hybrid. The same standard the big names charge triple for, without the sponsorships and the middlemen in the price.

collections.name: Wedges
collections.lede: Pick the loft you keep leaving yourself, and the finish you want to look down at.

collections.name: Putters
collections.lede: Two heads, same loft, same lie, same length. Which one you want comes down to how much the putter should tell you about a miss.

collections.name: Hybrid
collections.lede: One club, for when the green is a long way off and the lie isn't helping. Titanium, nineteen degrees, right or left hand.

collections.name: Polos
collections.lede: Cut to play in and comfortable enough to keep on afterwards. Thirteen patterns, and none of them shout.

collections.name: Hats
collections.lede: Ten of them, in the colours we actually wear. Pick the one that goes with the rest of what you own.

collections.name: Gear
